summary: Space Invaders entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Space Invaders

emulation.notes: Use original display/difficulty settings when possible.

primary.why: Hamster's Arcade Archives release of Space Invaders, Taito's 1978 shooting game, covers current platforms, alongside the arcade original and legacy ports. Arcade Archives is the cleanest official modern route for the original arcade game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives SPACE INVADERS using the original arcade display/settings options. Use a real cabinet only for hardware comparison and Invincible Collection only for wider franchise sampling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Invincible Collection is broader franchise context; for the standalone 1978 game, Arcade Archives is the more direct route.
